# DrawMaps product facts

DrawMaps turns the real-world map into a shared public drawing canvas. A user moves the map to a chosen location, zooms in, and creates with a pencil or leaves a colored pin containing a short message. Other people can discover public creations at the same map coordinates.

Current verified rules:

- Drawing is enabled at zoom level 18 or above.
- High-precision pins are enabled at zoom level 20 or above.
- Ink is capped at 100 points and regenerates by 1 point every 18 seconds.
- Larger strokes and broader map coverage consume more ink.
- Drawings are attached to geographic coordinates and loaded in geographic tiles.
- Authenticated Web and iOS clients share the account, canvas, ink balance, and blocked-user list.
- Offline drawing operations can queue locally and synchronize after connectivity returns.
- Users can report content, block users, and delete their accounts.
- DrawMaps does not request iOS device-location permission and does not collect GPS location. It stores map coordinates intentionally selected by the user.
